text.en:
Slug rounds shatter on impact into 7 semi-tracking submunitions that deal <pve 88 /> <pvp [5] /> damage each. Direct Slug Hits will deal damage with every submunition. 

Submunitions are unaffected by damage falloff and ricochet three times. They deal 18% reduced damage on the first bounce, then 42.5% reduced damage on subsequent bounces.

Submunitions will <bold attempt /> to steer towards enemies within 5 meters of their ricochet.
